title: An assistant that writes into the system of record.
summary: 98% of advisor teams using the assistant.

spec.problem: Advisors could not efficiently search about 100,000 internal research documents, and meeting notes were written by hand.
spec.changed: An assistant over internal research, then a meeting tool that, with client consent, drafts notes, surfaces actions, emails a summary and saves the note to the CRM.
spec.measured: Adoption by advisor team. No time or cost figures published.
spec.result: **98% of advisor teams using the assistant.** Adoption only; no savings figure. Company statements via InvestmentNews, June 2024.[^28]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
